messages:
lina: quick sync: i'm assembling a tiny docs bundle for embedding dashboards + a tracehook v2 migration note. aiming for a single PR with three commits: dashboard samples, tracehook migration checklist, and snippet/link fixes. any objections?
sam: sounds fine. for embeds we need an explicit security section (csp, token scoping, iframe sandbox). many customers copy-paste and forget the token expiry bit.
lina: agreed. drafting a short example. would prefer a minimal iframe and a recommended backend proxy snippet.
amar: can you add a note about token audience scoping and one-way tokens? also mention not to expose admin-scoped tokens in client iframes.
lina: yep. rough embed snippet:
```html
<!-- minimal, server-proxied embed -->
<iframe src="https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/embed/abcd-1234?session=${SESSION_TOKEN}"
        sandbox="allow-same-origin allow-scripts"
        style="width:100%;height:600px;border:0"></iframe>
```
and recommended proxy example (node):
```js
// server: exchange short-lived backend token for client session id
app.get('/dash/embed-token', async (req, res) => {
  const scoped = await redwood.issueSessionToken({scope: 'dash:embed', ttl: 300})
  res.json({session: scoped.token})
})
```
sam: good. include a CSP example header snippet and a one-line why: `frame-ancestors` to restrict who can host the iframe.
lina: added CSP note in draft: `Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' https://app.mycompany.com;`
amar: on tracehook migration: many teams are using the old shorthand `tracehook.add(...)`. we should show a tiny mapping table and a migration checklist: change calls, update typings, run smoke tests. i pasted a micro example: 
```js
// v1 (old)
tracehook.add('api.request', {route: '/predict', tags: {model: 'gpt-x'}})
// v2 (new)
tracehook.recordEvent({name: 'api.request', meta: {route: '/predict', model: 'gpt-x'}})
```
lina: perfect. i'll include a short tests section: run `make docs-snippet-check` + `yarn test:snippets` and confirm no lint errors.
docbot: heads up: when you open the PR the docs CI will run snippet-lint and linkcheck. If external links redirect, add `skip-linkcheck` in PR body and comment for reviewers.
sam: also flag to reviewers: the dashboard YAML uses public metric names (`redwood.cost.*`) in examples. don't include infra-only labels.
lina: noted. planning to split into three commits as mentioned. request reviewers: @sam and @amar for technical review, @docs-frontend for style. i'll push in ~2 hours.
deploy-bot: PR #4901: docs/embed-tracehook-bundle -> docs/main checks queued
lina: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4901 — adding reviewers and draft release notes. thanks all. :raised_hands:
